name: Spottr
desc: Spottr is a modern fitness application I developed that combines AI-powered coaching with comprehensive progress tracking. Built with the Anthropic Claude API, the app provides personalized workout routines and nutrition guidance through an intuitive chat interface

name: Civic Match
desc: CivicMatch is a full-stack political engagement platform I built using React and Node.js that aimed to connect Boston-area constituents with their representatives in a more interactive way.

name: Discrete Math Algorithms Calculator
